ThingDef.label: flesh hive
ThingDef.description: The foundation of a flesh hive. It can gestate fleshbeasts within the nest and spreads flesh carpet outward to expand the hive. Because of the artificially implanted dark archite shards, it can no longer expand without limit or draw nutrients from the surroundings on its own. It must instead rely on deliberate feeding, a far safer way to sustain the hive.

ThingDef.label: flesh primary nest
ThingDef.description: The core of a large flesh hive. It can gestate and fuse flesh beasts within the nest, and spreads flesh carpet outward to expand the hive. Because of the artificially implanted dark archite shard, it can no longer expand without limit or draw nutrients from the surroundings on its own. It must instead rely on deliberate feeding, a far safer way to sustain the hive. A hive can only support one flesh primary nest.

ThingDef.label: harnessed fleshmass heart
ThingDef.description: The primary organ of a fleshmass catastrophe. The heart draws material through roots extending deep underground. Once it has gathered enough, it spreads fleshmass around itself in cancer-like growth. It will continue growing until it consumes everything. Under the restraint of an archotechnological device, some of the heart's functions have been brought under control.\n\nThe heart can produce an endless supply of flesh and greatly expand the scale of a flesh hive. When needed, the harnessed fleshmass heart can consume a large amount of nutrition and transform into a harnessed fleshtitan to join the battle.

ThingDef.label: hive nerve bundle
ThingDef.description: A node in the fleshmass nervous system. It can expand hive scale and provide an independent hive control beacon. It spreads flesh carpet outward, expanding the hive. When fleshbeasts have low control, they need to return to the node to recover control, or they may enter a berserk state.

ThingDef.label: hive nerve center
ThingDef.description: The core node of the fleshmass nervous system. It can greatly expand hive scale and provide an independent hive control beacon. It spreads flesh carpet outward, expanding the hive. When fleshbeasts have low control, they need to return to the node to recover control, or they may enter a berserk state. A hive nerve center makes fleshbeasts easier to control.

ThingDef.label: flesh parasite vat
ThingDef.description: A flesh device made from sharp bone-spike tentacles and clotted flesh. It gradually devours fleshbeast cells and implants them into a host, allowing the fleshbeast to survive independently inside the host's body. The parasite strengthens its host and can actively attack the host's enemies, but its nutrition must be supplied by the host, causing the host to become hungry more easily.

ThingDef.label: flesh sack
ThingDef.description: A swollen sack of flesh. These immobile flesh beasts serve as digestive organs. Place living creatures inside to continuously supply the hive with nutrition. They cannot digest inorganic matter, and when digestion is complete they will eject desiccated remains.

ThingDef.label: flesh block
ThingDef.description: An impassable lump of twisted flesh. It pulses and trembles, filled with terrible vitality. It can support a roof.

ThingDef.label: chitin flesh block
ThingDef.description: An impassable lump of twisted flesh reinforced with hardened chitin. It pulses and trembles, filled with terrible vitality. It can support a roof.

ThingDef.label: flesh door
ThingDef.description: A door grown from twisted flesh. It writhes open for approaching creatures and seals the passage behind them.

ThingDef.label: flesh hopper
ThingDef.description: An organ that allows the flesh hive to vomit out internally processed products. Through a flesh hopper, the hive can be ordered to consume nutrition and produce supplies.

ThingDef.label: flesh vesicle
ThingDef.description: A flesh organ used for storage. Items kept inside it never age, and it does not affect the beauty of its surroundings. Any stored item with nutrition is automatically digested into hive nutrition. Other materials remain available for use by the flesh hive.

ThingDef.label: flesh barricade
ThingDef.description: A waist-high, sturdy lump of twisted flesh used to stop incoming bullets. Though unsightly, it provides better cover than other low objects. Flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

ThingDef.label: chitin flesh barricade
ThingDef.description: A waist-high, sturdy lump of twisted flesh reinforced with hardened chitin. It is used to stop incoming bullets. Though unsightly, it provides better cover than other low objects. Chitin flesh barricades will block certain animals the same way that fences do.

ThingDef.label: flesh bed
ThingDef.description: A single bed made of flesh. Soft flesh has grown into a pocket-like structure and a pillow for resting. It is unexpectedly comfortable, and those who rest on it recover from injuries more quickly.

ThingDef.label: flesh double bed
ThingDef.description: A double bed made of flesh. Soft flesh has grown into a pocket-like structure and pillows for resting. It is unexpectedly comfortable, and those who rest on it recover from injuries more quickly.

ThingDef.label: flesh column
ThingDef.description: A column made of flesh, used to support roofs. It does not block sight or movement.

ThingDef.label: flesh stool
ThingDef.description: A simple stool made of flesh for people to sit on. It is unexpectedly comfortable. It can be used near dining tables, workbenches, or elsewhere.

ThingDef.label: flesh table (1x2)
ThingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

ThingDef.label: flesh table (2x2)
ThingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

ThingDef.label: flesh table (2x4)
ThingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

ThingDef.label: flesh table (3x3)
ThingDef.description: A flat lump of flesh shaped into a table. People eat off it when chairs are placed facing it.

ThingDef.label: flesh power generator
ThingDef.description: Generates electricity by consuming hive nutrition, automatically drawing nutrition from the hive.

ThingDef.label: flesh lamp
ThingDef.description: A spherical lump of flesh. These fleshbeast organs refine and store nutrition for nearby flesh masses. This chemical process makes them emit a soft bioluminescent glow.

ThingDef.label: flesh tree
ThingDef.description: A towering tree made entirely of flesh. Infect a harbinger tree with twisted meat to transform it into a flesh tree. It feeds on nearby corpses, raw meat, and heads. Unlike a harbinger tree, the flesh tree is connected to the flesh hive: the nutrition it absorbs supports the whole hive instead of reproducing itself.

ThingDef.label: fleshberry bush
ThingDef.description: A strange fleshy mass with a few thorns, like a twisted copy of some ordinary shrub. It grows edible red fleshberries and yields a large amount of twisted meat when harvested.

ThingDef.label: chopped flesh tree stump
ThingDef.description: A stump left behind after a flesh tree has been felled.

ThingDef.label: smashed flesh tree stump
ThingDef.description: The pulped remains of a destroyed flesh tree.

ThingDef.label: weakened fissionmeld
ThingDef.description: A structure produced by a fissionmeld in its weakened state to prevent its own complete death.
